symptom: ako/mxcli#1917 (mendixlabs/mxcli#1723): after a green `mxcli test --attach` against `run --local --test-endpoint`, the hosting app answered 404 on dist/pages/<Module>.<Page>.js and every page showed the generic error dialog until the app was restarted. Reproduced on Linux with Mendix 11.12.6 (reported on Windows): dist/pages held 0 page modules after the attach.
cause: runAttached's applyModelChange built with a bare ServeServer pointed at the dev loop's serve port. Every attach build is a later build in that mxbuild --serve process, and on the prebuilt-client versions a later build replaces web/dist with a monolithic bundle without pages (mendixlabs/mxcli#1580). The dev loop's own reloads go through serveRecovery, which restarts the serve process on that outcome; the attach bypassed it, and could not reuse it as is, because the serve process belongs to the other mxcli.
file: cmd/mxcli/docker/serve_attached.go (AttachedServe: serveRecovery over a borrowedServe whose Restart starts a private mxbuild --serve on a free port instead of touching the host's; Close stops only that), cmd/mxcli/testrunner/runner_attach.go (builds through it, closes it when the attach ends)
insight: A recovery that lives in one process's loop does not travel with the API it drives: the attach called the same /build endpoint and inherited the defect but not the fix. Reuse the recovery and swap only its Restart for one this process owns — the host's serve is left in its stale state, which its own serveRecovery already handles on its next build. The cleanup build lands on the private serve as a later build too, so it restarts that one: two cold builds per attach, the price #1580 already set (correct beats fast). Integration test drives the reporter's sequence with a real 11.12.6 runtime and GETs a page module the boot produced (control: 200 before the attach); a binary whose AttachedServe.Build bypasses only the recovery fails it with 0 page modules left. A lingering java process after the run is mxbuild's Gradle daemon, not a leaked serve.
